news: After market close Meta reports Q4 2021: EPS $3.67 misses the $3.84 estimate; Q1 revenue guidance of $27-29B falls below the ~$30B consensus; first-ever quarterly decline in daily active users; Apple privacy changes are hurting ad revenue; Reality Labs operating loss widens.

Meta crashes ~26% in regular trading - the biggest one-day drop ever at the time - erasing ~$230B of market value; multiple analysts downgrade and slash targets (e.g. JPMorgan cuts to Neutral, target $385 to $284); other social stocks fall in sympathy (Snap, Pinterest, Twitter).
Selling continues as the 'the growth story is broken' narrative spreads; no rebound.
